title: Galvacord
extract:
Galvacord is a  Corpus heavy retractable whip with  Electricity damage and very high status chance, but very slow attack speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Electricity damage.
Stance slot has a  polarity, matching the  Burning Wasp stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Secura Lecta for the highest status chance of all whips.
